tasks.short: Confer with technical colleagues to resolve engineering problems

steps.what: Confer with scientific and technical colleagues to resolve design, research and testing problems

tasks.design: Retain the technical discussion and resolution with the engineer and colleagues, using evidence in {DOCS}. No separate preparation or minute-writing baseline is invented for this conversation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value lies in reconciling uncertain evidence and different technical explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest does not show that software can remove the engineer's substantive discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying what is not yet known and agreeing a defensible next investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can challenge reasoning and recognise the implications of an apparently minor uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in technical discussion or decision rights.

reach.task: Frame a testable engineering question for joint investigation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: resolving engineering problems through technical discussion remains human in this proposal; no discussion-time saving is demonstrated.

assumptions: Boundary is the petroleum engineer's participation, excluding colleagues' time and the investigations agreed during the discussion.

The engineer identifies problem scope, source revisions, observations, uncertainty and proposed next steps during s1. Their capture and interpretation remain fully counted; no free structured root-cause or resolved-problem flag is assumed.
Conflicting evidence triggers further human clarification rather than an automatic resolution. Existing native document and meeting tools are sufficient.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from introducing no new process, integration or generated minutes.
unknowns: Whether separate repetitive preparation exists outside the actual discussion
research_questions: Can time sampling distinguish evidence preparation from the substantive problem-solving conversation?

already_counted.description: Discuss evidence, challenge reasoning and agree next steps

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Routine design clarification and disputed test interpretation both retain full technical discussion time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret drilling and testing information for personnel

steps.what: Examine drilling and testing information and choose the evidence needed to answer personnel's questions
Prepare the selected drilling and testing charts with traceable source references
Check chart meaning, interpret the results and explain limitations to the personnel

tasks.design: Configure repeat comparison charts in {SPREADSHEET} from checked records exported from the drilling and test information system in {OTHER}. The engineer chooses the evidence and explains its meaning and limits; no dashboard output changes an operating instruction automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated plotting can consume time after the engineer has selected the relevant records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native chart templates can render explicit data ranges and units without interpreting the engineering result.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing data quality and explaining what the results imply under uncertain well conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can connect a trend with operational context and reject misleading comparisons.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated chart preparation; interpretation and operational decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the engineering limits of drilling and test information

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured charts can reproduce selected drilling and test comparisons, while engineering interpretation remains human; no measured saving is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary covers the engineer's evidence selection, plotting and explanation, excluding test execution and any operational action that follows.

OTHER means the drilling and test information system. In s1 the engineer produces well and run IDs, source revisions, time or depth ranges, units, quality exclusions and selected axes. Capture, reconciling timestamps and units, and manual correction remain fully counted.

Field technicians produce the original measurement records in the existing testing process; that unchanged acquisition work is outside this task. Added export-map maintenance is charged to other_role below.

Test native chart templates first. Missing provenance, unit conflicts or unmatched ranges stop chart generation and require manual plotting and interpretation in s3. Existing chart runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: How often plots are already generated natively
Whether drilling and test exports share usable identifiers and units
research_questions: Does a timed interpretation sample show manual plotting that can be removed without shortening checks or explanations?

already_counted.description: Select and validate records and check and explain chart meaning

incremental.description: Check chart exceptions and changed data mappings
Maintain export maps and chart templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives gross25, less focal upkeep7 gives net18. Range0-4 assumes most plots already exist and only a few repeat comparisons need manual preparation; interpretation and explanation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate research, planning and development workers

steps.what: Coordinate workers' research and development activities, resolving dependencies, priorities and technical constraints

tasks.design: Retain coordination discussions and decisions with the engineer, using the existing work record in {PROJECT}. No performance scoring, automatic worker assignment or invented scheduling-administration baseline is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dependencies and priorities change as technical uncertainty is resolved.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work records support visibility but do not remove the judgement and conversations in coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing resources and changing technical priorities without losing necessary investigations.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can negotiate trade-offs and recognise when a reported status hides a technical blocker.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in coordination responsibility or worker assignment authority.

reach.task: Explain technical dependencies and unresolved resource conflicts

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research and development coordination depends on technical judgement and agreement; no coordination-time saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's coordination work, excluding colleagues' execution time and separate project reporting tasks.

The engineer establishes activity, owner, dependency, target date, observed progress and unresolved blocker through s1. Capture and clarification are fully counted. Colleagues supply their actual status during the discussion, with no free structured completion or availability flag.
Uncertain progress or contested priorities require direct clarification; native work records remain a support tool rather than an automatic assignment authority.
No new process, monitoring system or integration is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether repeated administrative status collection is a distinct measurable task
research_questions: Does activity sampling show removable status transcription distinct from substantive coordination?

already_counted.description: Clarify status and dependencies and agree coordination decisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Stable work allocation and a contested technical dependency both retain full coordination time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write technical reports for engineering and management

steps.what: Select report evidence and establish the technical findings, uncertainties and intended management decisions
Write the technical report narrative from the selected evidence and engineer-authored conclusions

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory prose around conclusions already selected by the engineer
loop.input: Checked report evidence pack and engineer-authored conclusions
loop.output: Sectioned draft with source references and explicit uncertainty
loop.check: Engineer compares causal wording, caveats and every conclusion with the source evidence; fixed figures must remain unchanged
loop.stop: One draft and one correction attempt; unsupported claims or conflicting sources return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates can place figures but cannot express varied technical explanations; use fixed sections wherever prose generation adds no value

steps.what: Verify technical meaning and evidence, then issue the checked report to its intended personnel

tasks.design: Use native report templates in {DOCS} to place checked figures and a bounded drafting loop only for explanatory prose. The engineer supplies the conclusions, checks all technical meaning and source support, and approves the exact report version before issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning established technical findings into a readable report can require repeated prose drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step may express supplied conclusions without taking over the engineering analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Preventing polished prose from overstating causality, certainty or operational implications.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can recognise a technically misleading explanation even when every quoted figure is correct.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft writing; evidence selection, engineering conclusions and report accountability remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain engineering findings and decision limits in a clear report

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can express selected technical findings with engineer review, but the proposed petroleum-report saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is report writing after engineering analyses exist, excluding their creation, oral drilling interpretation and management action. Any reused chart preparation is assigned once in a roll-up.

The engineer produces report scope, source IDs and revisions, fixed figures and units, selected findings, causal limits, uncertainty statements and intended audience in s1. Capture and evidence reconciliation remain fully counted.

The loop uses that pack only, with no external retrieval or generated numeric results. Missing support or unclear conclusions cause manual writing in s2, whose remaining time includes meaning checks and correction.
Test native templates before a model loop. Added template and access upkeep is charged to other_role; focal ongoing exception review is additional below.
unknowns: Whether report prose drafting is a significant independent burden
Permission to process confidential technical evidence in a drafting environment
research_questions: Does a blinded report review find no added causal or uncertainty errors while total drafting and checking time falls?

already_counted.description: Select evidence, check drafted meaning and verify and issue the report

incremental.description: Review recurring drafting failures and maintain approved examples

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report snapshot, figures, source revisions, conclusions, caveats and recipients; edits require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gives gross14, less focal upkeep6 gives net8. Range0-2 assumes prose assistance works for only a small share of repeated report sections and correction consumes most drafting gains; engineering analysis and final checks retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated charts and first-draft prose while retaining interpretation, technical problem solving and research coordination.
reach: Explain engineering uncertainty to operations supervisors
Give project managers clear technical decision limits
skills_to_grow: Bounded report drafting and version approval
role.ambitious_version: A petroleum engineer who produces traceable explanations efficiently and keeps technical decisions grounded in checked evidence and human discussion.
